extraction.name: CommonCatalog
extraction.description: A dataset of Creative-Commons-licensed (CC) images with high-quality synthetic captions generated using BLIP-2.
extraction.creator: Aaron Gokaslan, A. Feder Cooper, Jasmine Collins, Landan Seguin, Austin Jacobson, Mihir Patel, Jonathan Frankle, Cory Stephenson, Volodymyr Kuleshov
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Started with the YFCC100M dataset of 100 million CC-licensed images. Re-scraped images from Flickr based on IDs provided in the YFCC100M metadata to obtain high-resolution versions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Almost all CC images lack the captions necessary to train a high-quality text-to-image model; those that do have associated text often just include the image title or a URL.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Excluded images with non-derivative (ND) licenses. Divided remaining images into commercial (C) and non-commercial (NC) subsets.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Center-cropped and resized all images to a maximum size of 512x512 pixels for captioning. At training time, images remain in native resolution.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Used a pre-trained BLIP-2 OPT2.5B model to produce high-quality, synthetic captions for the CC images.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: BLIP-2 captions are qualitatively more descriptive and higher quality than ground-truth alt-text captions (which often contain product names or poor grammar), but at the cost of caption diversity (reduced diversity of n-grams).
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Plan to augment CommonCatalog with Creative-Commons images from other sources in the future.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Addresses copyright concerns associated with web-scraped datasets by using only Creative-Commons-licensed images with known provenance, allowing for copying, adaptation, and commercial use.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The YFCC100M data is about a decade old; its CC images are not as current as those in LAION-2B. Synthetic captions have reduced diversity of n-grams.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: CC images are relatively scarce (roughly 70 million compared to LAION-2B's 2 billion). Lack of original captions. Images are not as current. Models trained on this data underperform in categories like faces, general photography, and paintings.
